title: Sajday Main Sar Kata Kay Shabbir Karbala Main
body:
Badli hai La Illah ki, taqdeer Karbala main
1- Asghar teray jihad ki, kiya dehe,r day misaal
Aye nazar lahu ki, taseer Karbala main
2- Touheed bach na paati, hota, na aaj parda
Laatay ager Hussain na, hamsheer Karbala main
3- Samjhi behen kay lout kay, Akbar, hai agaya
Gonjhi subhay Aashor jo, takbeer Karbala main
4- Thamay jigar ko apnay, Shabbi,r chun rahay hain
Bikhri howe Hasan ki, tasveer Karbala main
5- Deekha jo khawab Ahmed e, Mursal, ki ankh nay
Aus ko aata howe hai, tabeer Karbala main
6- Aik Maa kay dil main Shahid, paiwa,st aaj tak hai
Nikla tha jo kaman say, aik teer Karbala main
